source.quote: 4.1.1 קניה מכירה ופידיון של ניירות 0.54% משווי העסקה ₪ 35 ₪ 7,300

rate.notes: '0.54% משווי העסקה', charged on execution ('מיידי - בעת ביצוע הפעולה'). Footnote (1) to 'למעט קרנות נאמנות': includes a tracking fund (קרן מחקה) and a fund whose units are listed on TASE, so Israeli ETFs and listed fund units pay this line. Note (1): a split order pays one minimum per day. Note (2): an unexecuted order pays the minimum only if a clerk acted. Note (7): a zero-coupon government bond issued at a discount for up to one year pays a reduced 0.12% with a reduced minimum of NIS 25. Note (5): also charged on off-exchange trades with cash consideration. Tracking funds (2026-10-31): the exclusion of mutual funds on this line does not cover a tracking fund, so a tracking fund pays this line; a traditional fund that is not listed does not. Place: library cc45f15d6d9fec45 (the 01/10/2026 file), PDF page 13 (page 12 of the 2025 file 5fd0b860eaea10ee), line 4.1.1 "קניה, מכירה ופידיון של ניירות ערך הנסחרים בבורסה בתל אביב (למעט קרנות נאמנות(1)...", footnote (1): "אך לרבות 'קרן מחקה', כהגדרתה בחוק השקעות משותפות בנאמנות, התשנ"ד 1994 וכן של קרן להשקעות משותפות בנאמנות, שיחידותיה רשומות בבורסה לניירות ערך תל אביב". The same page names "מרכנתילטרייד" among the direct channels.

source.quote: 4.5.1 דמי ניהול פיקדון ני"ע 0.2% לרבעון ₪ 7,500

rate.notes: '0.2% לרבעון'. Collected at quarter end and/or on a transaction ('סוף רבעון ו/או מועד ביצוע פעולה'). Note (3): during the quarter the fee is charged on every balance reduction (sale, redemption, transfer) pro rata to the holding period from the start of the quarter, on the value in the transaction, subject to the per-security maximum per quarter. Note (4): at quarter end on the securities held on the last day, pro rata, on their value that day. Note (2): not charged on makam or on a money-market fund as defined in the 1994 assets regulations (recorded as excludes). Note (1): not chargeable on delisted securities (with an interested-party exception). Re-read 2026-11-04 in the 01/10/2026 file, unchanged (4.5.1, p.15). What customers paid (a fact, not a price): the exchange's sheet for Mercantile, 'עמלות ממוצעות בפועל לפי שווי תיק 01/01/26 - 30/06/26', read in Chrome 2026-11-04: Israeli custody 0.25% a year up to 25 thousand NIS, then 0.43, 0.40, 0.35, 0.35, 0.28, 0.23, 0.17, and 0.08% above 1,000 thousand; foreign custody 0.27, 0.44, 0.31, 0.32, 0.32, 0.27, 0.17, 0.12, 0.05. No sheet of its own was found on the bank's tariff page. Not put into `averages` (D56). Offers, none for the ordinary customer: annex A groups (0.1% a quarter, for a limited time) and the salary groups Top and Deluxe on the new-account-groups page ('דמי ניהול חשבון ני"ע - פטור', for 3 years, new joiners only; see left_out).
